name: MobileRisk-Live
description: MobileRisk-Live is a dynamic sandbox environment and safety detection benchmark for mobile GUI agents, featuring realistic trajectories with fine-grained annotations to detect unsafe operations in mobile environments.
reputation: A relatively new mobile safety benchmark that is emerging in the mobile-agent safety community, but it is not yet widely established as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark is part of MobileRisk-Live environment; includes hybrid safety detection framework OS-Sentinel combining formal verification and VLM-based contextual judgment.
